content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm having trouble connecting my [product_name] controller to a [product_name] HMI for the first time using FBD programming. Can anyone explain how to access marker flags and set up network-shared variable tags in the HMI? My setup involves one main controller and two sub-controllers.
Hi, Have you looked at this resource? It might be helpful and covers similar HMI topics: [url] [url]

For markers in [product_name], you don't need to change anything in the controller program. Marker statuses are exchanged by default. In [product_name] [article_no], marker addresses range from 1140 to 1117 (14 bytes in total). So, M1 corresponds to 1140.0, M2 to 1140.1, etc. You can find this information in the HELP section of [product_name] programming software under 'VM Mapping', which lists the addresses.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty linking a [product_name] PLC to an HMI using FBD programming, with issues surrounding how to access marker flags and network-shared variable tags, and where the associated addresses are found. It appears that the concept of VM mapping and marker addresses is not straightforward for new users, making it hard to find and apply the necessary information for HMI integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear, direct instructions for handling markers and shared variables with their HMI, including easy-to-understand details about address mapping for the specific hardware in use.
